records.title: Dynamic convolutional model based on distribution-collaboration strategy for remote sensing scene classification
records.reason: Primary abstract: ABSTRACT Most existing remote sensing image scene classification (RSISC) models rely mainly on cloud or terminal convolutional neural networks (CNN).

records.title: Calibrated Predictive Lower Bounds on Time-to-Unsafe-Sampling in LLMs
records.reason: Primary abstract: We introduce time-to-unsafe-sampling, a novel safety measure for generative models, defined as the number of generations required by a large language model (LLM) to trigger an unsafe (e.g., toxic) response.

records.title: Attribution-Guided Pruning for Insight and Control: Circuit Discovery and Targeted Correction in Small-scale LLMs
records.reason: Primary abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are widely deployed in real-world applications, yet their internal mechanisms remain difficult to interpret and control, limiting our ability to diagnose and correct undesirable behaviors.

records.title: Bridging the Digital Divide: Small Language Models as a Pathway for Physics and Photonics Education in Underdeveloped Regions
records.reason: Primary abstract: Limited infrastructure, scarce educational resources, and unreliable internet access often hinder physics and photonics education in underdeveloped regions.

records.title: TierTrain: Proactive Memory Tiering for CPU-Based DNN Training
records.reason: Primary abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) are one of the popular models for learning relationships between complex data.
